rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail from a single soft-focus plane and introduces staging nuance that is somewhat inconsistent with the provided 4AA label/hatching description.

Integrates age, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, diagnosis, and lifestyle factors well, though AMH is unavailable and the link between some factors and embryo competence is somewhat speculative.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable embryo quality tempered by prior failures and alcohol use; only minor issues such as overinterpreting cohort size and morphology from the image.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer for a good-quality blastocyst at age 34 and selective further workup after repeated failure; minor deviations include somewhat casual discussion of PGT-A and day-6 culture as strategy points.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including lifestyle modification, uterine reassessment, and review of prior cycle performance.
